column1: # FT3DR MAIN (H8S) frequency-plan tables.  All frequencies are 8-digit BCD in units of 10 Hz.
# vco_divider  file 0x037E54  9 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
#   LO -> VCO output divider. b: 1=/2 2=/4 3=/8 4=/16 5=/32 (map at 0x37EAE = 00 02 04 08 10 20). a=1 halves it again. Implies a 1050-2100 MHz VCO and continuous LO 46.875-999.995 MHz.
# frontend_a  file 0x0327AA  10 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
# frontend_a2  file 0x032812  5 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
# frontend_b  file 0x032C28  10 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
#   second front-end band map to 999.995 MHz (codes 1-3,5-11)
# frontend_c  file 0x032CA4  10 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
#   third front-end band map, 470/803 MHz split
# frontend_d  file 0x032D20  10 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
# band_108_230  file 0x035118  4 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
# rx_inhibit  file 0x020C78  5 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
# ars_2m  file 0x020CEE  5 records of 10 bytes {u32 BCD lower, u32 BCD upper, u8 a, u8 b}
#   2 m repeater-output sub-bands for automatic repeater shift (b=1/2 = shift direction)
